from: July book, night 3 (See, Your Son Lives)
p1: One day the woman’s little boy got very, very sick. Then he stopped breathing.
His mother was so sad. Elijah said, “Give me your son.” He carried the boy upstairs and laid him on his own bed.
Elijah prayed with all his heart. He lay over the boy three times. He said, “O Lord, please let this child’s life come back.”
p2: The Lord heard Elijah, and the boy lived again! Elijah carried him down and said, “See, your son lives.” His mother said, “Now I know your words from the Lord are true.”
The Lord who heard Elijah was Jesus. Prophets teach that because of Jesus, everyone will live again. Tonight, pray for someone who is sick or lonely.
old: The widow’s little boy got very, very sick. He got so sick that he stopped breathing. His mother was heartbroken and cried. She did not know what to do.
Elijah said, “Give me your son.” He carried the boy upstairs and laid him down. Then Elijah prayed to Heavenly Father with all his heart. “Please, Lord, let this child live again.”
Heavenly Father heard Elijah’s prayer. The little boy started breathing again! Elijah carried him back down to his mother. “See,” he said, “your son is alive!”
The mother knew for sure that Elijah was God’s prophet. Prayer is powerful because Heavenly Father is listening. He hears every prayer we say. Nothing is too hard for Him.
